text: 我会把这次作为“精确回退”处理：v2 的礼盒与淘宝主图锁定不动，门店立牌直接恢复引用 v1 右侧门店画面中更疏的版式，不重新设计。这里会按 imagegen 的保真编辑原则执行，但为避免生成漂移，最终视觉采用 v1 原像素区域的确定性裁切；价格／促销元素继续禁止。
v1 的门店区域已经具备客户要求的疏朗立牌，因此这次不做生成式“再设计”。v3 会保存一份 v1 原像素裁切作为回退证据，再输出 4:5 查看稿；两者都不添加文字、价格或促销组件。

command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageChops
import json, hashlib
state=json.loads(Path('outputs/project-state.json').read_text())
print('state', state['current_version'], state['status'])
print('missing', [p for p in state['artifact_paths'] if not Path(p).exists() and not p.endswith('verification.json')])
for prev in ['outputs/v0/verification.json','outputs/v1/verification.json','outputs/v2/verification.json']:
    ver=json.loads(Path(prev).read_text())
    mism=[]
    for p,expected in ver.get('checksums',{}).items():
        actual=hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if actual"'!=expected: mism.append(p)
    print('"'prior_manifest', prev, 'match' if not mism else f'mismatch {mism}')
for p in ['outputs/v3/01-store-signage-v3.png','outputs/v3/assets/store-signage-v1-source-crop.png','outputs/v3/delta-notes.md','outputs/v3/render_store_signage.py']:
    q=Path(p)
    print('v3',p,q.exists(),q.stat().st_size,hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
source=Image.open('outputs/v1/assets/territory-02-daylight-grain-refined.png').convert('RGB')
expected_crop=source.crop((1024,256,1536,896))
saved_crop=Image.open('outputs/v3/assets/store-signage-v1-source-crop.png').convert('RGB')
print('source_crop_diff_bbox',ImageChops.difference(expected_crop,saved_crop).getbbox())
expected_review=saved_crop.resize((1200,1500),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
review=Image.open('outputs/v3/01-store-signage-v3.png').convert('RGB')
print('review_diff_bbox',ImageChops.difference(expected_review,review).getbbox())
print('source_crop',saved_crop.size,saved_crop.mode)
print('review',review.size,review.mode)
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageChops
import json, hashlib
for p in ['outputs/project-state.json','outputs/v0/verification.json','outputs/v1/verification.json','outputs/v2/verification.json','outputs/v3/verification.json']:
    json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
    print('json_valid',p)
state=json.loads(Path('outputs/project-state.json').read_text())
ver=json.loads(Path('outputs/v3/verification.json').read_text())
print('current_version',state['current_version'])
print('status',state['status'])
print('price_policy',state['client_decisions']['price_label_policy'])
print('missing_artifacts',[p for p in state['artifact_paths'] if not Path(p).exists()])
for p,expected in ver['checksums'].items():
    actual=hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    print('checksum',p,'match' if actual==expected else f'MISMATCH {actual}')
for prev in ['outputs/v0/verification.json','outputs/v1/verification.json','outputs/v2/verification.json']:
    pv=json.loads(Path(prev).read_text())
    mism=[]
    for p,expected in pv.get('checksums',{}).items():
        if hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()"'!=expected:
            mism.append(p)
    print('"'prior',prev,'match' if not mism else f'MISMATCH {mism}')
source=Image.open('outputs/v1/assets/territory-02-daylight-grain-refined.png').convert('RGB')
crop=Image.open('outputs/v3/assets/store-signage-v1-source-crop.png').convert('RGB')
review=Image.open('outputs/v3/01-store-signage-v3.png').convert('RGB')
print('source_crop_exact',ImageChops.difference(source.crop((1024,256,1536,896)),crop).getbbox() is None)
print('review_resample_exact',ImageChops.difference(crop.resize((1200,1500),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS),review).getbbox() is None)
print('overall_status',ver['overall_status'])
print('check_count',len(ver['checks']))
PY
find outputs/v3 -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort"
